prerequisites: Configure the server request PathBase before routing, static assets and component endpoints. A proxy must preserve or correctly establish the external path base.
Use one base element with trailing slash. BasePath is Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.BasePath in RC2, in the Endpoints assembly; it is for the server-rendered Blazor Web App shell.
Canonical samples use net10.0/C# 14 and net11.0/C# 15 with independent global.json and locked SDK-aligned browser assets. No external provider, native workload or service account is required.

Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.dll, Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web.dll and Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Endpoints.dll from the .NET 11 shared/reference framework; SDK-aligned Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Internal.Assets 11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105 supplies browser files in the measured SDK.
Blazor Web App static document shell with BasePath; declarative links can be server-rendered.
Interactive Server canonical routed pages and imperative event handlers; WebAssembly/Auto not executed.
constraints: Blazor routing: NavigationManager.Uri is the current absolute URI; BaseUri is the application root. RelativeToCurrentUri defaults to false and uses the current route directory only when true.
Use relative destinations with RelativeToCurrentUri; RC2 rejects leading-slash and absolute destinations. It is not a path confinement or authorization mechanism.

GetUriWithFragment changes the current URI, preserving path/query and replacing the old fragment. Null/empty removes it; a leading # is optional. Supply a valid fragment; the helper does not escape arbitrary input.
No .NET 10 package/SDK compatibility route is claimed for the new APIs. The .NET 10 implementations are previous-release comparisons only.
